verdict.rationale: Skills are plain SKILL.md markdown files with YAML frontmatter, stored in readable folders (project/global), symlinked across agents, and explicitly designed for cross-agent reuse ('Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent') supporting 75+ agents. The CLI supports listing, copying, updating, and installing skills across harnesses (claude-code, cursor, opencode, codex, etc.), confirming portability rather than a proprietary binary format. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of actually moving a skill folder manually between two unsupported/arbitrary harnesses outside the CLI, and community comments note gaps in documented package-management practices (versioning/uninstall clarity).
